mapper.select: SELECT id, name, phone, course_balance AS courseBalance, points_balance AS pointsBalance FROM `user` WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND status = 1 AND course_balance <= #{threshold} ORDER BY course_balance

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.phone, (SELECT MAX(ck.check_time) FROM checkin ck WHERE ck.user_id = s.id) AS lastCheckin FROM `user` s WHERE s.store_id = #{storeId} AND s.status = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM checkin ck WHERE ck.user_id = s.id AND ck.check_time >= #{before}) ORDER BY lastCheckin
